newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to sum up year in radio address on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to sum up year in radio address on Friday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will deliver a radio address on Friday dedicated to the first anniversary of his second term in office, Yeltsin's press service said in a statement on Wednesday.

Yeltsin, who will begin a holiday on July 7, has a busy schedule until then including hosting talks and a state reception for visiting Azeri President Haydar Aliyev on Thursday. On Friday he will meet regional administration chiefs.
